programme.desc: Depending on the locations of the missions, Jacky Wu, the leader of the home team, invites various celebrities to take on challenges and bring you excitement every week.

programme.title: Flavor of Life
programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her family's beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings together.

programme.title: Flavor of Life
programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her family's beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings together.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad-tempered and lives alone. His forced retirement, failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter have left him in despair, prompting him to consider ending his life. Fortunately, he is rescued by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Three bizarre tales intertwine in this horror satire set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, where soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead!

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Veterinary assistant Zeming is pushed to the brink after a medical dispute. On the edge of life and death, he is drawn into a surreal realm of dreams and myth. Guided by a mysterious old man, he faces a brutal survival test, navigating illusion and reality in search of truth and awakening.

programme.title: MuMu
programme.desc: Mumu, a cheerful seven-year-old girl, lives with her deaf father in a deaf community and connects him to the outside world. However, their peaceful life is disrupted when her estranged mother reappears, pushing Mumu into the hearing world. Meanwhile, her father becomes ensnared by a gang that exploits the deaf to commit crimes.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Shadow's Edge, The
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves pulls off a massive billion-dollar heist while outsmarting the “Sky Eye” surveillance system, shocking the city. To stop the criminals before they strike again, Macau police enlist retired surveillance expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild an elite tracking squad and hunt down the elusive mastermind behind the operation.

programme.title: Soul Mate
programme.desc: July and An Sheng have been best friends since they were thirteen. They always believed their friendship would last forever, until they meet Su Jia Ming at the age of eighteen. The trio find themselves in a love triangle, which puts the girls' friendship to the test and alters their destinies.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping shocked China by coaching Team USA to victory against her home nation. Years later, when China's women's volleyball team fell into a slump, she returned to rebuild the squad and eventually led them to a historic gold medal triumph at the Rio 2016 Olympics.

programme.title: Call of Heroes
programme.desc: Set in 1914 following the collapse of the Qing dynasty, the action-packed Call of Heroes tells the story of a group of villagers standing up to a cruel young warlord to protect their homeland.

programme.title: Welcome to My Side
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung's mad fate?

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge—only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him…

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons Of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous “Twin Swords” in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because it's also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they inadvertently turn from vagabond kung-fu school operators into anti-Ching, patriotic fighters.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughter's lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: Kuttrame Thandanai
programme.desc: A visually impaired young man uses his sharp senses to solve a murder mystery and uncover the truth behind the crime.

programme.title: Annapoorani
programme.desc: A girl born in an orthodox family aspires to become India's best chef. She faces events and challenges on her way and goes beyond her conventional beliefs and prejudices to achieve her dream.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Idhu Kadhirvelan Kadhal
programme.desc: Kathir hates the idea of marriage, but when he falls for his sweet neighbor Pavithra, everything changes. Love blossoms. until heartbreak strikes, teaching him about love and loss.

programme.title: Akhanda
programme.desc: Akhanda, a devotee of Lord Shiva, protects Murali Krishna from Varadarajulu's evil scheme. The story unfolds with divine intervention, bringing justice in a captivating tale of righteousness.
After mobiles start mysteriously flying out of the hands of people in Chennai, Dr Vaseegaran summons his trusted robot Chitti to ward off the bird-shaped supernatural powers of Pakshirajan.

programme.title: Heartiley Battery
programme.desc: Sophia always grew up believing that love is nothing but a figment of science. At 24, she builds a Love Meter to evade heartbreaks and meets Sid, a free-spirited writer, who soon falls for her.

programme.title: The Great Indian Kitchen
programme.desc: Post her marriage, a woman tries to fit into the conventional mould that society has prescribed for married women. But somewhere along the way, she starts feeling that this is not the life she wants.

programme.title: The Greatest Of All Time
programme.desc: An elite agent retires for a quiet life, but when a past mission resurfaces, he reunites with his team to stop a catastrophic disaster, proving duty never truly fades away.

programme.title: Danny
programme.desc: Police inspector Kunthavai teams up with Danny, a clever police dog, to solve a murder mystery involving a dangerous gang of serial killers in this thrilling investigation.

programme.title: (L) UFC Fight Night: Hooker vs. Parnasse - Main
programme.desc: As UFC touches down at Accor Arena in Paris for the fifth consecutive year on Saturday, September 5, the main event features a fascinating lightweight pairing between Dan “The Hangman” Hooker and promotional newcomer Salahdine Parnasse. An all-action staple in the division for the last decade, New Zealand's Hooker headlines for the fourth time in his UFC career, looking to add to a win total that includes victories over Mateusz Gamrot and Jalin Turner. Hailing from Aubervilliers, France, the 28-yearold Parnasse was a two-division champion under the KSW banner, amassing seven successful title defenses while standing as one of the top talents competing outside of UFC

Nurmagomedov carries a 20-1 record into second main event assignment, having earned consecutive wins over Deiveson Figueiredo and Mario Bautista since coming up short on his attempt to claim the bantamweight title. The 28-year-old Song makes his second consecutive headlining turn in his home country, looking to build off his second-round submission win over Figueiredo in Macau in May while collecting the biggest win of his career.

Selepas Program berkenaan Khatijah memarahi Qasih sambil meluahkan rasa tidak senangnya dengan lelaki yang Qasih pilih. Alawiyah dan Khatijah meneruskan rancangannya untuk merapatkan Jazlan dan Qasih dengan menganjurkan Program Buka Kitab di rumah Alawiyah dengan Jazlan sebagai penceramahnya. programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah mengenang saat dia kehilangan ibu dan bapanya, segala kenangan diimbas kembali dengan kesedihan yang tidak tertanggung. Kini, hidup Aisyah di penuhi dengan rasa sedih atas layanan dan sikap Mak Su Ainin dan dua orang sepupunya Fasha dan Farid. Aisyah melakukan semua pekerjaan di rumah selain mencari duit untuk diberikan kepada Mak Su Ainin sekeluarga. Sementara Fasha dan Farid hanya menanti Aisyah menandatangi surat penyerahan tanah kepada mereka yang dimiliki oleh arwah ibu dan bapa Aisyah. Semua ini atas arahan dan ajaran dari Mak Su Ainin. Iskandar lelaki yang hidup dengan kekayaan dan serba sempurna. Di kelilingi gadis-gadis cantik jelita persis model. Kehidupan dengan mengejar jawatan yang dijanjikan sebagai CEO di TG Holdings membuatkan Iskandar semakin hanyut melayari keseronokkan. Namun, cara hidup Iskandar tidak disenangi oleh Tengku Maria. Tengku Maria mula mencari jalan dengan menjodohkan Iskandar dengan Tengku Waiduri. Hal itu membuatkan Iskandar memberontak dan meminta Haziq membawanya bercuti.

programme.desc: Khatijah memarahi anaknya Qasih kerana bertanyakan soalan yang sensitif kepada Jazlan di hadapan orang ramai. Aishah pula mencadangkan kepada ibunya untuk memberitahu Alawiyah bahawa sebelum sesuatu program tausiyah bermula perlu diadakan maulud dahulu. Khatijah membawa Qasih ke rumah Alawiyah bertujuan supaya Qasih meminta maaf dengan Jazlan. Khatijah bersetuju untuk berjumpa dengan Aidy, teman lelaki Qasih memberitahu Aidy yang beliau hanya menerima menantu yang sama nasabnya iaitu keturunan Syed. programme.desc: Satu demi satu kebenaran diterima. Mereka belajar memaafkan dan melepaskan.

programme.title: Tiger Cage III
programme.desc: James dan John sedang bekerja di Biro Jenayah Komersial. Mereka bersama-sama menyiasat satu kes yang suspeknya adalah seorang ahli perniagaan kaya yang berpengaruh bernama Lee. James mempunyai teman wanita bernama Suki yang bekerja untuk Wong, akauntan Lee.

programme.title: Kanang Anak Langkau
programme.desc: Sebuah filem berdasarkan kisah benar Sarjan Kanang Anak Langkau, seorang pahlawan iban dan pahlawan perang yang paling terkenal di negara ini, yang berjuang dengan berani semasa pemberontakan komunis.

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain (Haji Zul Ariffin), ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK) yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian (Nur Fazura), ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra (Farid Kamil), yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie (Izara Aishah) dan Jiman (Iedil Putra), Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK), kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato' Hashim. Ketika Dato' Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Ceroboh
programme.desc: Selepas dunia dilanda makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Penunggu Langit—yang mampu mengawal minda manusia—enam rakan berlindung di sebuah bangunan usang. Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Ganjil
programme.desc: Alam mimpi telah menjadi tempat percutian Nabila dan Amry. Semasa mereka berkongsi harapan dan ketakutan antara satu sama lain, mereka belajar tentang masalah yang harus mereka selesaikan dalam kehidupan masing-masing di dunia nyata.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China
programme.desc: Selepas Perang China-Jepun, Army of the Rising Sun cuba untuk menguasai wilayah Guangdong dengan sebuah organisasi rahsia. Guru Seni Mempertahankan Diri Wong Fei-Hung dan pelajar-pelajarnya cuba menghentikan serangan ini.

programme.title: Parole Examiner Lee EP1
programme.desc: Lee Han-shin memulakan tugas baharunya sebagai pemeriksa pembebasan bersyarat dan mendapati sistem itu dipengaruhi oleh kuasa serta wang. Dalam masa yang sama, detektif Ahn Seo-yoon menyiasat kes pembunuhan yang berkait dengan keluarga chaebol Ojung Group.

programme.title: Spirit Whisker: The Revenant
programme.desc: Seorang anak sulung keluarga kaya yang telah meninggal dunia tiba-tiba hidup semula selepas seekor kucing hitam misteri melompat ke atas mayatnya, yang membawa kepada kelakuannya yang pelik dan ganas yang menyebabkan keluarga itu huru-hara dan menimbulkan rahsia gelap di kalangan mereka.

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

programme.title: The Equalizer S1 EP3
programme.desc: McCall berusaha membantu seorang banduan yang melarikan diri setelah dituduh membunuh secara salah, tetapi dia terlalu tidak percaya kepada sistem keadilan yang telah mengecewakannya untuk menerima bantuan McCall. Selain itu, McCall mula risau apabila anak perempuannya, Delilah, berhenti bergaul dengan seorang rakan karibnya, manakala pencarian Detektif Dante terhadap McCall mengambil satu arah yang tidak dijangka.

Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. programme.desc: Selepas menyelamatkan Nadia (Afifah Nasir), seorang wanita moden yang telah lama diminatinya, Adnan (Aiman Tino), seorang penghantar makanan, mula jatuh cinta tanpa menyedari bahawa dia mungkin terperangkap dalam rancangan tersembunyi wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Kau Langit Aku Laut
programme.desc: Kau Langit Aku Laut mengisahkan pasangan kekasih yang mempunyai banyak perbezaan dan sering bergaduh. Mereka cuba pertahankan hubungan walaupun banyak cabaran dan salah faham.

programme.title: By My Side
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Faye dan Ben membesar bersama di Subang Jaya dan akhirnya jatuh cinta serta menjalinkan hubungan. Namun hubungan mereka diuji apabila Ben merancang untuk ke Australia, memaksa Faye belajar menghadapi cinta jarak jauh dan kehidupan tanpa dia.

programme.title: La Tahzan
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Viona, seorang wanita Indonesia yang tinggal di Jepun dan bekerja sebagai pengurus rumah kepada keluarga Muslim. Kehidupannya berubah apabila dia bertemu dengan Hasan, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan kisah silam dan rahsia dalam perkahwinannya. Konflik timbul apabila cinta, kepercayaan dan pengorbanan diuji, membawa Viona kepada perjalanan memahami makna kesabaran, keikhlasan dan ketentuan Tuhan.

programme.title: Hello Goodbye
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Indra dan Dara, pasangan muda yang berdepan cabaran dalam hubungan mereka apabila impian, jarak dan masalah peribadi mula menguji kekuatan cinta mereka. Kisah ini mengetengahkan tentang pengorbanan, keluarga, harapan serta erti melepaskan seseorang yang disayangi demi kebahagiaan masing-masing.

programme.title: Diari Abah
programme.desc: Rahmat dipulaukan oleh tiga anaknya, Annur, Zarif & Zakuan, setelah berkahwin buat kali kedua dengan Ashikin, ibu tunggal anak satu. Anak-anaknya menganggap kematian ibu mereka, Khalijad berpunca daripada keputusan Rahmat berkahwin lain. Namun mereka semua tersedar apabila Ashikin telah menyerahkan sebuah diari kepada mereka bertiga setelah Rahmat meninggal dunia. Tercatat dalam diari itu bahawa segala duit yang dikirimkan setiap bulan digunakan abah mereka untuk mendirikan rumah anak yatim atas permintaan arwah ibu mereka dengan nama Rumah Anak Yatim Cik Khalijah.

programme.title: Hi Guys
programme.desc: Sebuah siri separa dokumentari yang menyeronokkan dan dikendalikan oleh sekumpulan hos cilik yang penuh tenaga. Mereka meneroka pelbagai tempat menarik dan aktiviti yang mengujakan, sambil berkongsi pengalaman dengan semangat ingin tahu dan keceriaan. Setiap episod membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan yang dipenuhi tawa dan penemuan baharu, sambil menggalakkan kanak-kanak untuk belajar serta mengenali dunia di sekeliling mereka dengan cara yang menyeronokkan dan menarik.

programme.title: Saleha

Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.desc: Denis dikenali sebagai seorang yang baik, peramah dan sentiasa menenangkan orang di sekelilingnya. Namun, di sebalik sikap mesranya, tersimpan sisi gelap yang tidak diketahui sesiapa. Lama-kelamaan, sikap sebenar Denis mula terserlah apabila tindakannya menjadi semakin manipulatif dan membahayakan orang di sekelilingnya.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Liza's On Line (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Liza Wang, Sammy Leung, William So, and Dickson Yu have teamed up to create a game show, inviting members of the entertainment family and guests to participate in a "Werewolf Palace Edition" game, revealing their foolish and clever sides. Guests will also tell exaggerated "true or false stories" to attract attention, allowing for speculation on whether the events are real or fake! Following her magical touch from the previous season, Ah Jie will again stir up topics at the "Cheat Chat" dinner table. Who can bring the most entertainment? Ah Jie has a wide circle of acquaintances, inviting guests from different fields, including Mak Ling Ling, Nancy Sit, Laurinda Ho, Philip Keung, Alex Fong, and Chin Ka-lok, to compete for the best performance and generous prizes!

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The core premise revolves around TVB's eligible single female artists (dubbed the "Goddesses") who participate in an unscripted journey to find real romance. Single male contestants from all walks of life—recruited through a worldwide open casting call—compete through speed dates, interactive challenges, and romantic one-on-one dates to win their hearts.

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4" has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating "masked," igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants; Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new season's stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4."

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: Dear Leslie 70
programme.desc: Dear Leslie 70 is a TVB Jade memorial music special honoring the 70th birth anniversary of Hong Kong legend Leslie Cheung. The show celebrates his legacy across Cantopop, TV, and cinema by showcasing iconic archival performances, classic hits like "Monica" and "Chase," and tribute covers by fellow artists. It also features personal stories and memories shared by close friends, including Leo Ku performing the tribute song "Dear Leslie."

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. " Cantopop At 50" invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: Finance Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "Financial Insights" keeps a close watch on the market, reviewing weekly trends in Hong Kong stocks and paying attention to the real estate sector. Through exclusive interviews with industry professionals and market analysis, the program explores popular local and international finance topics in a clear and accessible manner. It also features in-depth reports on the challenges faced by different industries as they develop.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip & What's On Today
programme.desc: Japan's railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname "Tetsuko" (meaning "railway girl"). The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether you're a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, "Tetsuko's Lofty Mountain" offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu (Samantha Ko) suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai (Jonathan Cheung). She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man (Rosita Kwok), and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can “take over” her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Tang Mist & What's On Today
programme.desc: Set during the Chuigong era of the Wu Zhou/Tang Dynasty, the story follows Di Renjie as he grows disillusioned with the political intrigues of Empress Wu Zetian's imperial court. Leaving the capital to inspect the southern Jiangnan region, he is drawn into a series of five strange, seemingly supernatural cases

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: News Roundup

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: They are young. They are bold. They sweat. They fall in love - on the beach. YIP CHING (YEO VIVIEN), YIP KIU (LI SZE YAN) and YIP YAN (CHEN CHI YIU) are sisters. When they were young, they met a Gypsy girl (YUNG CHO YEE, JOEY) who foresaw that CHING would meet her true love, who has a four-leafed clover birthmark, when she turns eighteen. In the blink of an eye, the sisters have grown up and are now sixth-formers at the Greenwood International School. The beach volleyball team captain YUE YAT SUN (SZETO SHUI KI), a star student, is handsome and cheerful. Many girls join the team just for him. The sisters see a four-leafed clover birthmark which matches the description given by the Gypsy girl on SUN from three different angles. However, CHING is indecisive and lacks confidence. KIU and YAN are busy trying to set up chances for her to be with SUN. The three sisters join the beach volleyball team. Remarkably, they also find the same birthmark on a bad student named NIC FONG (CHoi KAY CHUN). The sisters are confused, unsure about who is CHING's true love…

programme.title: Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. Also due to his gourmet background, he gets to know a street performer KEI MO-SUET (Joey Meng), the most beautiful girl in Peking NIAN RUOBI (Nancy Wu) and teen celebrity chef MAI SIU-YU (Stephanie Ho), etc. As fate would have it, he comes across Prince YINZHEN (Ben Wong), who is making a tour in disguise, and the two share similar interests. Later on, he is recommended for an imperial chef in the palace, where he runs into his archrival CHOI HOK-TING (Bob Lam), resulting in consecutive fierce battles between them. Meanwhile, TIN-PO has no idea he has been caught in the plot that Prince YINSI (Louis Cheung) hatches to become the rightful heir to the throne. Under such disadvantage, TIN-PO becomes the man who brings luck to Prince YINZHEN, continuously turning the tide for him before his defeat. However, an unexpected betrothal brings him down from the lofty position to the most inferior one of a stray dog......

programme.title: Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: Food supplier LO KAI-FONG (Kitty Yuen) is a short, average, thirtysomething dating virgin, and she serendipitously helps a young restaurateur, LAU PAK-YIP (Jason Chan), overcome adversity, making this drop-dead gorgeous uncover and value her inner beauty. Gradually, their love grows, which KAI-FONG's neighbour and best friend, KO KWAI-FUN (Samantha Ko), cannot let go of. Though fish peddler KWAI-FUN, whose beauty resembles a stunning diva, tries every means possible to flirt with PAK-YIP, she still cannot create any chemistry with him. Unexpectedly, HUNG SIN (King Kong), heir to a Taiwanese Tan-Tsu noodles business, begins to take a fancy to KWAI-FUN, and he even roughs it in the subdivided flat together with KAI-FONG and the others so as to get to know KWAI-FUN better. Since KWAI-FUN's effort goes unnoticed by PAK-YIP, she shifts her focus to court his uncle, LAU LEI-KO (Timothy Cheng). Later on, facing growing negative criticism over his girlfriend KAI-FONG, PAK-YIP cannot bear it anymore, which eventually sours his relationship with KAI-FONG. When there's no such thing as unconditional love, and the line between good and bad becomes blurred, love transforms to a predatory affair, catapulting everyone, both male and female, to the brink of war......

programme.title: ICAC Investigators 2022
programme.desc: Rewind ten years and Tong Wai-chung (Benjamin Yuen) and Shum O-ming (Shuan Tam) join ICAC at the same time. The duo become brotherly buddies as they undergo training together. O-ming is injured as he carries out some arbitrary operation. He then tenders his resignation, and no one has heard from him ever since. Fast forward ten years and Wai-chung is promoted to Chief Investigator. Wai-chung and his subordinates, including Lee Chun-yee (Sisley Choi) and Shorty (Hera Chan), are committed to maintaining probity and righteousness. While investigating a suspected bank staff corruption case, Wai-chung realizes O-ming is surprisingly implicated. Actually, O-ming uses investigation experience he gained at ICAC to assist some crime syndicate in repeatedly foiling criminal and anti-corruption investigation activities in different regions. Wai-chung is saddened by his buddy forgetting the original aim was to defend fairness and righteousness when they joined ICAC. He is determined to bring the crime syndicate to justice!

The beach volleyball team captain YUE YAT SUN (SZETO SHUI KI), a star student, is handsome and cheerful. Many girls join the team just for him. The sisters see a four-leafed clover birthmark which matches the description given by the Gypsy girl on SUN from three different angles. However, CHING is indecisive and lacks confidence. KIU and YAN are busy trying to set up chances for her to be with SUN. The three sisters join the beach volleyball team. Remarkably, they also find the same birthmark on a bad student named NIC FONG (CHoi KAY CHUN). The sisters are confused, unsure about who is CHING's true love…

programme.title: Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. Also due to his gourmet background, he gets to know a street performer KEI MO-SUET (Joey Meng), the most beautiful girl in Peking NIAN RUOBI (Nancy Wu) and teen celebrity chef MAI SIU-YU (Stephanie Ho), etc. As fate would have it, he comes across Prince YINZHEN (Ben Wong), who is making a tour in disguise, and the two share similar interests. Later on, he is recommended for an imperial chef in the palace, where he runs into his archrival CHOI HOK-TING (Bob Lam), resulting in consecutive fierce battles between them. Meanwhile, TIN-PO has no idea he has been caught in the plot that Prince YINSI (Louis Cheung) hatches to become the rightful heir to the throne. Under such disadvantage, TIN-PO becomes the man who brings luck to Prince YINZHEN, continuously turning the tide for him before his defeat. However, an unexpected betrothal brings him down from the lofty position to the most inferior one of a stray dog......

programme.title: Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: Food supplier LO KAI-FONG (Kitty Yuen) is a short, average, thirtysomething dating virgin, and she serendipitously helps a young restaurateur, LAU PAK-YIP (Jason Chan), overcome adversity, making this drop-dead gorgeous uncover and value her inner beauty. Gradually, their love grows, which KAI-FONG's neighbour and best friend, KO KWAI-FUN (Samantha Ko), cannot let go of. Though fish peddler KWAI-FUN, whose beauty resembles a stunning diva, tries every means possible to flirt with PAK-YIP, she still cannot create any chemistry with him. Unexpectedly, HUNG SIN (King Kong), heir to a Taiwanese Tan-Tsu noodles business, begins to take a fancy to KWAI-FUN, and he even roughs it in the subdivided flat together with KAI-FONG and the others so as to get to know KWAI-FUN better. Since KWAI-FUN's effort goes unnoticed by PAK-YIP, she shifts her focus to court his uncle, LAU LEI-KO (Timothy Cheng). Later on, facing growing negative criticism over his girlfriend KAI-FONG, PAK-YIP cannot bear it anymore, which eventually sours his relationship with KAI-FONG. When there's no such thing as unconditional love, and the line between good and bad becomes blurred, love transforms to a predatory affair, catapulting everyone, both male and female, to the brink of war......

programme.title: ICAC Investigators 2022
programme.desc: Rewind ten years and Tong Wai-chung (Benjamin Yuen) and Shum O-ming (Shuan Tam) join ICAC at the same time. The duo become brotherly buddies as they undergo training together. O-ming is injured as he carries out some arbitrary operation. He then tenders his resignation, and no one has heard from him ever since. Fast forward ten years and Wai-chung is promoted to Chief Investigator. Wai-chung and his subordinates, including Lee Chun-yee (Sisley Choi) and Shorty (Hera Chan), are committed to maintaining probity and righteousness. While investigating a suspected bank staff corruption case, Wai-chung realizes O-ming is surprisingly implicated. Actually, O-ming uses investigation experience he gained at ICAC to assist some crime syndicate in repeatedly foiling criminal and anti-corruption investigation activities in different regions. Wai-chung is saddened by his buddy forgetting the original aim was to defend fairness and righteousness when they joined ICAC. He is determined to bring the crime syndicate to justice!

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: You're Just Not Her
programme.desc: Food company sales manager Lam Shun (Karl Ting) and boutique boss Ha Lee (Crystal Fung) have been cohabiting for so long that they have little loving feelings for each other. As regards the future, the couple also see things differently. Between these two lovers, there are more and more contradictions and frustrations as time passes, and they are getting out of hand. Lam Shun and Ha Lee have a row and end up causing a traffic accident. After surviving this ordeal, Ha Lee becomes another person as she is passionate and straightforward in contrast to her previous practical and virtuous personality. Everything revolves around Lam Shun. She even intervenes into his social circle. In particular, his elder sister Lam Sin (Stephanie Che), boss Mak Mei-na (Claire Yiu), adversary Lok Wai-to (Jonathan Cheung) and brotherly buddies Muk Ka-kit (Mark Ma) and Au Man (Telford Wong) are greatly affected. Lam Shun tails Ha Lee, and their romantic relationship is rekindled. He feels like when he first met her. But the person before his eyes seems to be another person. Lam Shun just wonders whether she really still loves him?

programme.title: Executioner, The
programme.desc: In order to protect his benefactor's daughter-in-law, YUEN SO-SUM (Elaine Yiu), throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, cold-blooded executioner YIP SHEUNG-LUK (Kenny Wong) arranges for SO-SUM to settle down in the home of a renowned midwife in town, FA YUI-HUNG (Maggie Shiu). As such, they run into an obscure murder, and SHEUNG-LUK even uses his saber to help save a new life. Due to the unknown background of this newborn baby boy, SHEUNG-LUK and YUI-HUNG are involuntarily caught up in the whirlwind of political infighting. As a team, they play cohesively and competently despite being poles apart in personality, managing to avert disaster over and over again. Slowly, their love grows in the face of adversity. On the other hand, childhood sweethearts CHIK CHI-TSAU (Matt Yeung) and CHUK SIU-MOON (Katy Kung), who grow up together in a brothel, arrive at YUI-HUNG's home, beseeching SHEUNG-LUK to take CHI-TSAU as his apprentice. In fact, CHI-TSAU is up to something as he attempts to take advantage of this to avoid punishment, so SHEUNG-LUK cannot make up his mind. With the sudden appearance of a mysterious magician, SZEMA CAU (Joel Chan), they all get entangled in complicated relationships. Gradually, the real identity of the baby boy is unmasked, sounding the death knell in the meantime......

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Certified Protection Officer (CPO) HA TIN-HANG (Mat Yeung) is relocated from England to Hong Kong on a mission to protect a web leader named CHEUNG FEI-FAN (Vincent Wong), while searching for his birth family. Flamboyant and conceited FEI-FAN holds a sham boxing championship to cover the arrival of hackers, but gets himself into trouble in the process, fortunately TIN-HANG manages to help him out. The incident attracts the attention of a hot-headed cop named HO TIT-NAM (Philip Ng), who relentlessly probes into the matter. It turns out that TIT-NAM made an unspeakable mistake on impulse, resulting in a radical change of his personality. With the boxing championship rousing their combative instincts, the gradual discovery of their telepathic abilities enables them to help each other through that common bond. Such an underlying close connection can even be traced back to a financial crisis twenty years ago……

programme.desc: It is more than just a food and travel show as it is a cultural journey. The program blends travel, cuisine, and culture, inviting viewers not only to taste but also to experience the stories, people, and places behind Taiwanese food and destinations. Through lively food challenges, scenic explorations, and authentic local encounters, the hosts bring audiences closer to Taiwans diverse flavors and vibrant traditions.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu & his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung's mad fate?

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: After Goddess Nuwa sacrifices herself to save the mortal world, Monkey King comes into being from one of her crystals. Powerful and uncontrollable, Monkey King challenges the Jade Emperor and causes an uproar in heaven, unwittingly creating an opportunity for the wicked Buffalo Demon King to wage war in heaven.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Adapted from true events, Fraudster Dai swindled countless victims across China before vanishing without a trace. Seven years later, he resurfaces in Paris. Led by Detective Ye Jun, the Chinese Fox Hunt Team launches a high-stakes cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the pursuit.

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wang's only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life.

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: A massive fire caused by illegal garbage smuggling has triggered a radiation crisis in Hong Kong. Government advisor Simon joins the crisis response team led by Acting Chief Executive to avert the disaster. A fire brigade is tasked to enter the radiation zone and stop the cesium fallout. Facing the unprecedented catastrophe, can they save the city?

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: Struggling with Alzheimer's disease, Hong Kong film buff Kim relies on his brother to manage their appliance repair shop. Kim's quirky behaviour prompts producer Ginger to suspect that he may be a film critic trying to profit from harsh reviews. Posing as a friend, Ginger uncovers Kim's secrets and sorrows as she gets closer to him and his family.

programme.title: Welcome to My Side
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation…

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng recalls his violent childhood memories when he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. While he has to prevent the tragedy involving a suicidal student from happening, he also has to face a series of family problems with his wife wanting to divorce him and his father's serious illness.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wen's imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth.

programme.title: I Want to be Rich
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. Against all odds, his resilience and determination to provide a better life for his family eventually lead him to achieve significant success in real estate—a testament that perseverance pays off.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When some gangsters led by a ruthless American property developer force a school to sell their land, Ip Man fights to protect it. Subsequently, Ip Man is challenged by another Wing Chun master Zhang Tian Zhi for the Grandmaster title. Ip Man accepts the challenge for the sake of his family and disciples, and wins the duel for the title.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty, and their father's drug addiction. Initially, the sisters attempt to appease him, but as they enter adolescence, they ultimately rebel and escape. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent's son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan's elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Yun Fei Yang, a Wudang servant hiding his identity as the sect leader's illegitimate son, is framed by long-hidden enemies and branded a traitor after losing his father. Hunted by rival forces and stripped of his martial arts, he masters the legendary “Tian Chan Gong” and rises again to clear his name and settle a generations-old blood feud.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: Danny
programme.desc: Police inspector Kunthavai teams up with Danny, a clever police dog, to solve a murder mystery involving a dangerous gang of serial killers in this thrilling investigation.

programme.title: Rajamahal
programme.desc: Rudra, a mentalist and a medium, helps track down a ghost that is haunting a resort.

programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Ayam Goreng Cili Kering & Oden Ekspres sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Hullera.

programme.title: TENGOK APE TU
programme.desc: Untuk episod kali ini kita akan menonton sambil bercerita tentang drama bersiri 'BARAJIWA' dan sebuah rancangan televisyen bertajuk 'DEKO BAJET'.

programme.title: SEMBANG SELEBRITI
programme.desc: Sembang selebriti merupakan rancangan bual bicara bersama selebriti yang menceritakan tentang pengalaman mereka di dalam dunia seni tanahair yang boleh dijadikan sumber inspirasi. Episod kali ini menampilkan Fezrul Khan sebagai selebriti jemputan.

programme.title: TRENDSETTER
programme.desc: Trendsetter bersama Zakuan Zainal menampilkan Bigbones dalam segmen Usya Kedai dan Deena Erissa untuk Gaya & Kerjaya. Bagi segmen Bedah Kotak pula, Muhammad Mirzan mengupas secara terperinci keunikan beg mewah edisi khas LV Yayoi Kusama Neverfull.

programme.title: KLTV 2026
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan informasi yang memfokuskan tentang dunia hiburan di Malaysia dari pelancaran music & wayang terbaru, isu isu panas terkini dan juga rancanga/Siri best untuk dilayan.

programme.title: DAPUR BUJANG WESTERN
programme.desc: Rancangan ini memaparkan Chef Naem yang akan berkongsi menu masakan yang mudah dan enak. Dalam episod kali ini, Chef akan menyediakan Ayam Rangup, Mayonis Biji Sawi & Sayur Jeruk bersama Ayam Panggang & Humus.

programme.title: RONDA RODA
programme.desc: Saksikan kepakaran teknikal Dave BMW Doctor di Gegar Garage dan gaya hidup unik bersama Ilham Chopper dalam Borak Motorkar, sebelum diakhiri dengan reviu SUV mewah Bentley Bentayga (Review Kereta).

programme.title: CELEBS DAY OFF
programme.desc: Saksikan bagaimana seorang selebriti mengisi hari cuti mereka dengan bermacam aktiviti-aktiviti menarik. Dihoskan oleh Asmawi, anda akan mengenali lebih lanjut kisah kehidupan dan karier tetamu undangan kali ini, Cleo.

programme.title: TERBAIK DARI JALANAN
programme.desc: Ikuti Suffren dan Banni dalam jelajah mereka menikmati makanan-makanan terbaik dari gerai, warung dan kedai kaki lima. Untuk episod kali ini, mereka akan pergi ke Station Nasi Kerabu, Bilal Nasi Kandar dan Calisto.

programme.title: LUBUK
programme.desc: Rancangan khas yang akan membawa anda ke tempat menarik dari sungai hinggalah ke tempat tersembunyi untuk memancing. Kali ni, kita ke lubuk memancing di Kong Kong, Pasir Gudang, Johor bersama Joe Aziz.

programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Datin Anne Ngasri, Fikry Ibrahim, Ainina Ahmad B, NAKI dan Fiza Thomas.

programme.title: TRENDSETTER
programme.desc: Trendsetter bersama Zakuan Zainal menampilkan Alwis & Xavier dalam segmen Usya Kedai, manakala Izzat dari Bello & Co untuk Gaya & Kerjaya. Bagi segmen Bedah Kotak, perincian dan keunikan beg mewah Dior Saddle Bag akan dikupas secara terperinci.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Khatijah memarahi anaknya Qasih kerana bertanyakan soalan yang sensitif kepada Jazlan di hadapan orang ramai. Aishah pula mencadangkan kepada ibunya untuk memberitahu Alawiyah bahawa sebelum sesuatu program tausiyah bermula perlu diadakan maulud dahulu. Khatijah membawa Qasih ke rumah Alawiyah bertujuan supaya Qasih meminta maaf dengan Jazlan. Khatijah bersetuju untuk berjumpa dengan Aidy, teman lelaki Qasih memberitahu Aidy yang beliau hanya menerima menantu yang sama nasabnya iaitu keturunan Syed. Jazlan membawa berita gembira kepada Alawiyah yang beliau telah mendapat biasiswa untuk sambung pelajarannya di Madinah

programme.title: Mr Delicious
programme.desc: Satu demi satu kebenaran diterima. Mereka belajar memaafkan dan melepaskan.

programme.title: Miss & Mrs
programme.desc: Kisah tiga sekawan iaitu Geetha, Airin and Chew, yang berjumpa di hari minggu and mereka akan mengadakan sesi gossip and sharing problem. Masing-masing dengan tekanan and konflik tersendiri.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah melakukan kerjanya seperti biasa di dalam rumah yang tidak pernah memunculkan bahagia padanya. Farid memerhatikan bentuk tubuh Aisyah dan berniat mahu menganggu Aisyah. Mujur ketika itu suara Mak Su Ainin muncul dan mematahkan niat buruk Farid terhadap Aisyah. Sementara Fasha sememangnya membenci Aisyah dan tidak menyukai Aisyah apatah lagi buah hati Fasha, Iwan tertarik dengan Aisyah. Tengku Maria semakin tidak senang dengan gaya hidup Iskandar yang semakin menjadi-jadi. Tengku Maria mengambil keputusan untuk tidak lagi berbincang secara baik dengan Iskandar berkenaan niatnya mahu menjodohkan Iskandar dengan Tengku Waiduri tetapi Tengku Maria terus memaksa Iskandar untuk menerima segala yang telah dirancang jika mahu kedudukan Iskandar kekal. Tertekan dengan keadaan itu, Iskandar melarikan diri sementara ke Cameron Highlands dengan tujuan mengambil ketenangan bersama Haziq. Aisyah dalam perjalanan pulang selepas berjumpa dengan Ros. Dia membawa basikal dan kainnya tersangkut. Ketika itu muncul kereta Iskandar dan menyebabkan Aisyah panik dan terjatuh.
